    force = -K_p * theta - K_d * omega + K_pos * (target_x - x) - K_vel * v

    # Safety margin correction
    margin_right = (target_x + safe_half_range) - x
    margin_left = x - (target_x - safe_half_range)

    if margin_right < 0.02:
        force += -K_safe * (x - (target_x + safe_half_range))
    elif margin_left < 0.02:
        force += K_safe * (x - (target_x - safe_half_range))

    # Apply force within the new actuator limit
    lim = 50.0
    sandbox.apply_cart_force(max(-lim, min(lim, force)))
